types.name: AnswerValue
types.doc: What a question or a repeating group holds in an answer map: a question's BlockValue, or a repeating group's instances, in order, each its own answer map (contract section 12.4).

types.name: Answers
types.doc: Answers keyed by block id — the whole form's, or one instance's. The shape every /core entry point takes, the payload carries and drafts store. It never holds instance ids.

types.name: BlockValue
types.doc: The value held for one block. Generic over T because different block types hold fundamentally different value shapes: - short -> BlockValue<string> - checkbox -> BlockValue<string[]> - matrix / instrument (later) -> BlockValue<Record<string, ...>> Defaults to `unknown` rather than `string` — this is the honest type at any boundary (registry, FormRenderer's state) that has to hold every block type together without knowing which one it has. Each block component narrows T to its own concrete shape. Two states only: 'answered' | 'empty'. What "partially answered" means for a composite value (e.g. 4 of 9 PHQ-9 items filled) is handled inside that block's own component, not modeled here.
